title: StandingPolicyPayload
description: Source of truth: this schema IS the authoritative shape for Manifest{kind: 'standing-policy'} payload_json. Authored as a DHT Manifest entry via create_manifest (existing coordinator). The substrate reads this payload to derive standing rules and accumulation status projections. Category A (Notarized) via existing Manifest entry type.

floor.description: Constitutional floor — immune classes that standing policy may not restrict

recognition_weight_by_level.description: Recognition weight per governance mechanism level. The substrate reads this map to compose the EconomicEvent resource_quantity_value when a governance participation event is recorded. Maps integer level keys (0–7) to float weights (0.0–1.0). Higher-friction mechanisms earn more: level 0–1 (reaction, context-menu) earn 0.1; level 2–3 (graduated feedback, approval) earn 0.3–0.5; level 4–6 (ranked-choice, score, consent) earn 0.7–0.8; level 7 (deliberation) earns 1.0. When omitted, the substrate uses protocol defaults. Source of truth: Manifest{kind: 'standing-policy'} payload_json authored via create_manifest coordinator (Category A via existing Manifest entry type). Replaces client-side WEIGHT_BY_LEVEL constant (F-POLICY-3).

accumulation_thresholds.description: Thresholds governing AccumulationStatus derivation from FeedbackSignal aggregates. When omitted, the substrate uses protocol defaults.

readyForSensemaking.description: Signal accumulation has produced enough diversity to warrant structured deliberation

controversyDetected.description: High participation with highly diverse views — active controversy present

settled.description: Strong consensus with sufficient participation — community has converged

accumulation_threshold.description: A threshold pair: minimum total signals required AND maximum consensus_strength allowed (or minimum for 'settled').

minTotalSignals.description: Minimum total signal count that must be reached before this status is eligible

maxConsensusStrength.description: For readyForSensemaking and controversyDetected: consensus_strength must be BELOW this value. For settled: consensus_strength must be AT OR ABOVE this value (substrate interprets field name as min when used in the 'settled' threshold context).
